card.name: Inside German surnames like Herzog
card.fires_on: Middle pieces of German-style surnames, such as Herz, Hertz, Holtz and Hertie, when the name is split into parts. It fires on the piece after the first syllable, such as the z in Holtz or the Herz in Herzog.

modes.label: Herzog name
modes.description: The Herz piece at the start of the surname Herzog, in names of professors or filmmakers.

modes.label: Other German surnames
modes.description: Later pieces in surnames like Holtz, Hertz, Hertie or Kirchhoff.
